strategies.name: abc_trend_continuation_reclaim
strategies.entry_summary: With 4h/1h bullish, drop to 15m/5m and track corrective lower-highs/lower-lows; enter long once price stops making lower lows (higher low) AND breaks back above the last lower high (ABC reclaim).
strategies.exit_summary: Stop under the swing low; target 1h high, scale with trend (~1:10 up to ~1:32 if 4h breaks); gestural 'scalp out' for the scalp variant.
